description: The next prompts to answer for a table's AI columns, up to 200 at a time: blank cells first, then answers whose row or instruction has changed. Answer each prompt yourself, then send the answers back with fill_ai_cells, each with its `row` and `basis`. Repeat until it says `done`. `redo` also re-answers generated values that came from outside the instruction. Needs a token.

column.description: One AI column's id or label. Leave out for the first one with work waiting

name: next_ai_cells
